rota.membersAddedHereCanBeAssigned: Members added here can be assigned when instances are generated.

rota.noSlotsOnThisInstanceYet: No slots on this instance yet.

rota.nothingScheduledInTheNextDays: Nothing scheduled in the next 180 days.

rota.optionalWhyYouCanTMake: Optional: why you can't make it

rota.whyIsThisBeingApprovedRejected: Why is this being approved / rejected?
rota.yourRotaLeadIsNotifiedAnd: Your rota lead is notified and can offer this slot to another member of the pool. Add a note if there’s context that helps.

souls.whatDidYouShareAnythingTo: What did you share? Anything to follow up on?
